# Hash-pinned requirements for the CI installs, all --require-hashes:
# the "Install zizmor" step in actionlint.yml installs the whole file, and
# tests.yml lifts the ruff, coverage and pylint blocks with awk and installs
# each in its own venv: the coverage cell and the diff-coverage job take the
# coverage block alone, and the type/lint venv takes it beside the pylint
# block, because the tree that venv lints imports coverage
# (.github/scripts/diff_coverage.py). A version pin alone still installs
# whatever artifact the index serves for that version; these sha256 hashes
# make the install the same bytes on every run.
#
# What the hashes have to cover is the wheel each consumer's runner
# resolves: actionlint.yml's ubuntu-latest runner takes x86_64 glibc,
# CPython 3.13, and tests.yml's matrix adds macos-latest, which takes an
# arm64 macOS wheel. zizmor declares no runtime dependencies, so PyYAML is
# the whole transitive closure; ruff and coverage ship none, so their
# blocks install alone; and the type/lint block carries the nine
# dependencies pylint, pycodestyle and pyright resolve -- astroid, dill,
# isort, mccabe, mypy_extensions, nodeenv, platformdirs, tomlkit and
# typing_extensions. Every block lists every artifact its closure ships,
# so it resolves on whichever platform lifts it.
#
# The `pip` entry in .github/dependabot.yml watches this directory, so a
# version bump arrives as a pull request with the --hash lines rewritten
# beside it, and the set it writes is every artifact the release ships
# rather than that one platform's. With `--require-hashes` that superset is
# accepted and the runner's wheel is matched out of it. If Dependabot
# cannot resolve the new version's hashes the update opens no pull request
# and the pin stays where it is, so the procedure below is the fallback.
# To regenerate the hashes for this platform by hand instead of copying
# them from a release page --
#
#   python3 -m pip download -d /tmp/req-dl zizmor==<new> PyYAML==<new> ruff==<new> coverage==<new>
#   sha256sum /tmp/req-dl/*
#
# then rewrite the --hash lines from that output. If a bump introduces a
# new transitive dependency, add a requirement line for it too:
# hash-checking mode still resolves dependencies and refuses any it cannot
# pin, so a dep the file omits fails the install loudly -- the sha256sum
# output above lists every artifact in the closure.
# All four consumers re-run when the file changes: actionlint.yml's push
# trigger is paths-ignore of four documentation files, which a change
# here never matches, and tests.yml's push and pull_request triggers
# are unfiltered.
